releaseName: Amounts with dollar signs and commas
notes: Fixed amounts pasted or typed with a dollar sign or commas. Copying a balance like "$8,432.19" from your bank and pasting it used to leave the box empty, so you got an error telling you to enter a balance you had just entered. Every amount box in the app now accepts what you actually paste.
Fixed the edit screen refusing to save without saying why. If something needed correcting, the message was being drawn behind the edit window where you could not see it.
Messages about a missing rate or an unusual APR now appear in the form like every other message, instead of as a pop-up.
